title: Bushiroad Streams Ghost Meets Gal Anime on YouTube
content: Bushiroad added all three episodes of the mini anime adaptation of Kaeru DX 's Ghost Meets Gal manga on its Cardfight!! Vanguard YouTube channel on Friday. The series is available with Japanese audio and English subtitles. Karin Kagami (voice of Urara Haneyama in Cardfight!!

title: 2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote
content: Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards. Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19.
author: ANN

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Recasts Ryōtarō Dōjima
content: The " Persona 4 Revival TV" livestream announced on Sunday that Ryōtarō Okiayu is voicing the character Ryōtarō Dōjima in Atlus ' Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game. Okiayu replaces the late Unshō Ishizuka , who originally voiced the character until his death in 2018.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" by Mori Tsubasa
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Eleventh Ending Featuring "Smile for..." by Ueto Aya
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The song was used in Episodes 127-139, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ram Fights Lye in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 18 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 18 (Episode 84 overall) preview ahead of its September 23 2026 premiere. This will be the seventh episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .

title: 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Announces Supporting Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki 's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ( So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ) manga announced supporting cast on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 10.00 p.m.

title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Anime Reveals More Cast, Character Visuals

title: 'Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume' Anime's New Trailer Previews Opening Song
content: The staff for Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , the original television anime based on the Tetsudō Musume (Railway Girls) characters, started streaming the anime's pre-broadcast promotional video on Sunday. The video previews the previously announced opening theme song "GO! GO! RAILWAY!!" by artist Asaka .
author: ANN
